_description: H6a: Tighten proximity filter from 0.85 to 0.88. Tests whether requiring stocks to be within 12% of 52W high (vs 15%) improves WR in bad regimes by admitting only stronger momentum setups. Built on baseline_v5 (H1 integrated).
_hypothesis: H3 showed loosening proximity (0.85->0.80) hurt bad-regime WR. H6a tests the inverse: tightening to 0.88 should admit only the highest-momentum setups and improve WR, at the cost of fewer trades.
_baseline: Compare to h1_floor_jan_mar and h1_floor_jul_sep. H1 baseline: Jan-Mar +26.0% (WR 57.4%, R:R 2.04, margin +24.5pp) / Jul-Sep +2.3% (WR 38.9%, R:R 2.01, margin +5.6pp).
